draft.emotion: polite and helpful, like a customer making a standard, friendly request
notes: Polite request form of 주다 (to give).
Used after a noun (물 주세요, 'water, please') or after a verb in the -아/어 form (먹어 주세요, 'please eat it').

senses.definition: Used after a noun to politely ask for that item, or after a verb (-아/어 주세요) to ask someone to do that action.
